description: A home that can retain its original owners for nearly seven decades, affording them the opportunity to happily raise four children, must hold something very special indeed. Come harness all its’ positive energy to create a lifetime of happiness for you. Situated on a desirable quiet cul-de-sac where those same four children relished countless hours of frolic, cementing cherished childhood memories. Inside this warm wonderful abode, discover hardwood flooring throughout and a spacious living room with beautiful wood beam ceilings, classic brick fireplace and unique bar. An adjacent dining area also offers a charming brick fireplace. Large upper-level primary suite features a walk-in closet and private bathroom. Three bedrooms and two additional baths add to the appeal. Outside enjoy covered dining/entertaining and grassy area. Newer roof, newer water heater plus an extra-large driveway further enhance. Live in just the way it is or remodel to your hearts’ desire. In addition, your mere moments to Cedars/Tarzana medical center and just a short stroll to the Blvd. As an added bonus, all schools for this home are sought-after charter schools. Don’t miss!
